title: Toothy's Discount Dental
description: A paid message from Toothy's. A smile is just teeth showing off.

lines.text: Got a toothache? <p:0.2> Toothy's Discount Dental pulls ALL your teeth for the price of one! <p:0.2> No appointment, no anesthetic, no questions. <p:0.2> Toothy's, we'll find the bad one eventually!

lines.text: Procedures performed by a man named Greg. <p:0> Number of teeth removed may exceed the number present. <p:0> Gums sold separately. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
